text: On 13 April 2022 businessman Alexander Udodov became the sole owner of the Pin-Up.ru company; the same day, the Fonbet bookmaker's site named Pin-Up.ru as its owner. Stavka.TV (September 2026) repeats that Udodov acquired Fonbet in 2022, while noting that the register (EGRUL) names AO Klir Tsentr as the founder of licence holder OOO Fonkor.
short: Fonbet's site named Pin-Up.ru (Alexander Udodov) as its owner in April 2022 (The Bell).

source.name: The Bell: Бывший зять Мишустина купил крупнейшую в России букмекерскую сеть
source.quote: Бизнесмен Александр Удодов с 13 апреля стал единственным владельцем компании «Пин-Ап.ру»
source.note: The article adds that on the same day Fonbet's site 'в качестве ее владельца указана «Пин-Ап.ру»' (named Pin-Up.ru as its owner).

additionalSources.name: Stavka.TV: Компания Фонбет: история основания и кто владелец
additionalSources.quote: В 2022 году «Фонбет» приобрел бизнесмен Александр Удодов
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'In 2022, the businessman Alexander Udodov acquired Fonbet.' The page also says the licence holder is OOO 'Fonkor' and, citing the register (EGRUL), names AO 'Klir Tsentr' as its founder - Klir Tsentr's owner is not identified.
